title: Daily digest: From east to west, Hyderabad gets a spel | BJP demands action on rising rice prices | Excise Academy to get a modern makeover,
headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
bullets_en: From east to west, Hyderabad gets a spell of rain on Friday evening.
BJP has sought action on rising rice prices, continues protest against Jawaharnagar dumpyard.
Excise Academy to get a modern makeover, says Keralam Minister M. Liju.
bullets_ur: Mashriq se maghrib tak, Juma ki shaam Hyderabad mein baarish hui.
BJP ne chawal ki barhti qeematon par karrawai ka mutalaba kiya, Jawaharnagar dumpyard par ehtijaj jari hai.
Excise Academy ko jadeed banaya jayega, Keralam ke wazir M. Liju ka kehna hai
